ctx.note: Context length in tokens. Minimum llama-server version supporting this exact flag name is not verified against a changelog; the flag has existed for a long time under this name.

ngl.note: Number of model layers offloaded to GPU. Version floor not verified.

tensor_split.note: Only meaningful for splitting a model across more than one GPU.

split_mode.note: Layer/row split strategy across GPUs; meaningless with a single device.

main_gpu.note: Selects the primary GPU for scratch buffers; accepted with any GPU count.

batch_size.note: Logical batch size for prompt processing.

cache_type_k.note: KV-cache quantization for K requires flash attention in llama.cpp; a value other than f16/f32 without flash_attn enabled is rejected by the server itself.

cache_type_v.note: Same requirement as cache_type_k, for V.

mtp.note: Multi-token-prediction speculative decoding; only meaningful when the served model documents an MTP head. since is unverified because the flag name has moved between llama.cpp releases.

fit.note: Automatic memory-fit heuristic; not present in every llama.cpp fork/build, minimum version not verified.

n_cpu_moe.note: Offloads the given number of MoE expert tensors to CPU; only meaningful for a mixture-of-experts architecture. llama.cpp does not have a vLLM/SGLang-style 'expert parallel' flag — this is the equivalent MoE-specific control for this implementation.

ctx.note: Context length. Version floor not verified.

cache_type_k.note: llama-cpp-python exposes this as an integer ggml type enum rather than llama.cpp's string names; Faustus's own request normalizer (_normalize_llama_cpp_python_cache_types) does that mapping before launch. Unlike llama-server, this wrapper does not gate the flag behind flash attention support being requested, because it has no --flash-attn flag to gate against in the first place.

cache_type_v.note: Same mapping as cache_type_k, for V.

ctx.note: Maximum served context length. Version floor not verified.

gpu_mem.note: Fraction of device memory vLLM is allowed to pre-allocate for KV cache.

expert_parallel.note: Only meaningful for a mixture-of-experts model.

moe_env.note: Faustus's own MoE-optimization environment-variable bundle for vLLM launches (see detectModelOptimizations); a real vLLM setting only in the sense that it sets vLLM's own env-controlled feature flags, gated the same way as expert_parallel.

ctx.note: Maximum served context length. Version floor not verified.

gpu_mem.note: Static GPU memory fraction reserved for weights/KV cache.

expert_parallel.note: Only meaningful for a mixture-of-experts model.

num_ctx.note: Per-request context window; documented in Ollama's FAQ as a request-scoped option, not a server flag.

keep_alive.note: Per-request idle-unload timer; request-scoped per Ollama's FAQ.

flash_attn.note: Server-global environment toggle; cannot be set per conversation/request.

kv_cache_type.note: Server-global KV-cache quantization; Ollama's FAQ documents this as requiring flash attention to be enabled, same dependency as llama.cpp's own cache_type_k/v.

ctx.note: MLX serving wrappers vary by fork; the exact flag and its minimum supporting version are not verified here.
